snippet.title: Sturmjäger Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sturmjäger (シュトゥルムイェーガー) is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. 🪐🛸💥

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... shoot it anyway, just to be safe 🤪

*SOCIAL MEDIA*
